sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1 (06:30 – 14:30)
items: Equipment received: 2 x Swipe Cards, 5 sets of keys, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam.

Echo Route commenced, patrolling up Queen Street ensuring our presence is visible. Welfare check along McDonald's Queen Street, 77 Convenience Store and Mid City, all clear. Quick standby to maintain a strong presence.
Welfare check along Remedy Coffee, all clear.
Arrived at the Aotea Square check-in; full sweep completed within the area, all clear. Remaining stationed here to provide our services to any response calls or incidents.
Welfare check along Auckland Library, all clear.
Arrived at the check-in at the corner of Lorne Street and Wellesley Street, all clear. Commencing welfare checks on all stores along Lorne Street.
Commencing welfare checks along all stores within High Street, all clear.
Arrived at Freyberg Place and the Women's Memorial Hall; no issues or vagrants found.
Arrived at the Chancery Square check-in; full sweep completed within the vicinity, all clear. Standing by to ensure a strong security presence.
Arrived at the Wilson Carpark check-in; welfare check along The Right Track and Jo & Joes, all clear.
Arrived at the check-in at the bottom of Fort Street; welfare checks commenced along all stores, all clear. Quick standby to show our presence.
Arrived at the Kiwibank check-in and all stores nearby, all clear.
Arrived at the Commercial Bay check-in; full walkthrough commenced with welfare checks along the way, all clear. Remaining stationed at TK Square to ensure no issues arise.

Response call from The Right Track reporting a male individual causing a disturbance within the property line; the individual was consuming alcohol not bought from the business and sitting at their tables and chairs.
Arrived at the response location; had a word with the individual and asked him to move along. He is now standing at Walker and Hall, so we will remain stationed here until further notice.
Continuing patrols as the individual has finally moved along. Ending Echo Route.
Charlie Route commenced. Welfare check inside Imperial Lane; floor checks completed, no issues found.
Arrived at the Commercial Bay check-in; ensuring a strong security presence due to many minors visible.
Welfare check completed along Woolworths Metro and Aotea Gifts, all clear.
Arrived at the check-in at the Customs Street and Albert Street intersection; area thoroughly checked, all clear.
Welfare check along Albert Mart Convenience Store and Discount Dairy; follow-up check completed, no issues.
Arrived at Federal Square; welfare check around the Cathedral church completed, all clear.
Report made by Community Patrol members of a group of street vagrants smoking and consuming alcohol on Fort Street.

Arrived at the response location, Fort Street. Heavy presence of street vagrants but no visible signs of anyone smoking cannabis; the same male who was moved on from The Right Track earlier is the only one visibly consuming alcohol, riding around on his e-scooter. Standing by to ensure our presence is visible and watching for further issues.
No further issues found; continuing patrols.
Patrolling up Queen Street ensuring a strong security presence and commencing welfare checks on all stores and businesses along the way, all clear:
Arrived at the intersection of Queen Street and Victoria Street, all clear.
Report made by Community Patrol of a group of minors who stole from St Pierre Sushi.

Arrived at the location where the theft was committed; had a word with the store manager at St Pierre Sushi and retrieved a photo description of the group of minors. (Photo on file.) Continuing to stand by to ensure our presence is known.
Arrived at the bottom of Fort Street; standing by while awaiting further response calls.
Continuing patrols and making our way to the next checkpoint.

Response call from Nike, which they ended straight away; we called them back and they advised it was okay as Police were already outside. Continuing patrols up Queen Street ensuring a strong security presence.
Welfare check along Woolworths and Chemist Warehouse Victoria Street, all clear.

Arrived at the check-in at the top of Victoria Street; welfare check commenced along all stores within the area, all clear. Standing by to ensure a strong security presence while awaiting response calls.
Welfare check completed within the Crowne Plaza Hotel, making our way down towards Atrium on Elliott and the food court, all clear.
Arrived at the Aotea Square check-in, the last checkpoint for Charlie Route; full scope of the area, no issues found. Checked on Jack's Fried Chicken and Metro Entertainment City, all clear.
En route to HQ for lunch break.
Arrived at HQ; lunch break commenced.
Morning Shift completed; changeover to the Afternoon Shift.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 22:30)
items: Equipment received: 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 2 x Radio, 2 x Bodycam, 1 x Swipe Key.
Debrief with the Morning Shift complete; both guards were already downstairs before the shift started and commenced patrols from the bottom of HQ.
Welfare check complete at Nike Queen Street, no issues.
Welfare check completed at Cotton On Queen Street, no issues.
Welfare check completed at Unichem Queen Street, no issues.
Welfare check completed at McDonald's Queen Street, no issues.
Darby Street sweep complete, no issues; welfare check complete at Recycle Boutique.
Elliott Street sweep complete, no issues.
Welfare check at Elliott Stables complete, no issues.
Wellesley Street sweep complete, all clear.
Albert Street, Mayoral Drive and Myers Street sweep, all clear.
Arrived at the back of Q Theatre; completed a thorough welfare check and met with Karen, no issues.
Response call from 33 Lorne Street regarding an intoxicated vagrant in the store; staff requested his immediate removal. Heading over now.
Spoke to the worker; the individual inside is intoxicated and the worker is worried for his safety.
Escorted the individual outside of the building (Footage on file.) and got in touch with his mother. The individual is going through a tough time in life, and his mother asked us to look after him.
After explaining the situation to the individual, we decided to escort him to Britomart to help him sober up and hop onto the train to New Lynn.
Standing by at Bao and Noodles to help get him some food.
The workers said he was there this morning and had left his water canister and sandwich. Continuing to stand by.
The individual entered another restaurant and ordered more food; standing by to ensure his safety.
Contacted emergency services and requested assistance to get the individual home safely. Standing by with him on Queen Street waiting for emergency services.
Emergency services have arrived; handing the individual over to them.
Commencing patrols of the Lower Queen Street areas.
Ops Phone at low battery; heading back to HQ to charge it to a sufficient level.
Arrived at HQ; charging the Ops Phone and standing by for response calls.
Received a call from Footlocker regarding suspicious individuals in store; heading over now.
Received information from management to move an individual from a private property area; heading over after the first response call due to the urgency of the first call.
Received another call from the convenience store on Victoria Street near Federal Street regarding a vagrant outside the store using illegal substances; heading over there after the first call.
Arrived at Footlocker and got the individuals out of the store. Standing by maintaining presence.
Heading over to the second response call.
Arrived at Midtown Mini Supermarket; the individual had already left before we arrived. Welfare check completed on the store, no issues. Standing by for security presence.
Heading over to High Street for a full sweep.
Arrived at High Street; commencing a sweep of the whole street.
High Street, Vulcan Lane and Chancery Square sweep completed; standing by for security presence.
Fort Street, Fort Lane, Wilson Carpark, Right Track, KFC, Vapor King, Vape Haven, Haven Mart, 77 Convenience, White Lady and Jo & Joes all clear, no issues to report. Heading towards Gore Street.
Auckland Harbour Suites, Smiley Mart, Chargrill, Sal's Pizza, Giapo and City Liquor all clear. Standing by for security presence.
Welfare check on Sol, 77 Convenience Store, Custom Mart, Burger Fuel and Q Convenience Store. Heading towards McDonald's Britomart.
McDonald's Britomart and TK Square all clear. Standing by for security presence.
Charging the Ops Phone, which is on 2%.
Having break; phone is on 43%. Will respond to any calls.

sections.title: Night Shift (22:30 – 06:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.
On standby in the office awaiting guard arrival.
Guard has arrived; charging the Ops Phone before commencing full patrols.
Welfare check at Partridge and the outside entrance of Hour Glass, all clear, no issues. Continuing patrols.
Full sweep of Queen Street with welfare checks, all clear, no issues. Commencing a sweep at Britomart.
Full sweep of Britomart complete; welfare check at McDonald's, all clear. Patrolling down Quay Street.
Welfare check with the Kemuri guard, all clear. Patrolling Quay Street.
Full sweep of Quay Street, all clear. Patrolling the Viaduct to commence welfare checks.
Arrived at Danny Doolans; standing by maintaining presence (00:34–00:45).
Welfare check at Danny Doolans, all clear. Patrolling through Customs Street to Albert Street.
Customs Street all clear; arrived at Albert Street, patrolling the area.
Full sweep of Albert Street; welfare check at Albert Mart, all clear. Arrived at Ace Karaoke, maintaining presence in the area.
Welfare check at Ace Karaoke Bar, all clear. Commencing a sweep at Federal Square.
Full sweep of Federal Square; welfare checks at the Cathedral and Liston House, all clear, no issues.

As we were about to leave Federal Square, a female approached us crying and staying close to us, saying she had lost her phone with no idea where it was. Offered her assistance by calling it many times with no answer, then offered to call relatives to give her a ride; standing by until her ride arrives.
Still standing by with the female awaiting her ride.
The female individual has been safely escorted to her ride. Continuing patrols through Federal Street.
Federal Street all clear, no issues. Patrolling down Victoria Street.
Full sweep of Victoria Street; welfare check at Skymart Convenience Store, all clear. Arrived at High Street, patrolling the area.
Arrived at Freyberg Place; commencing a sweep of the area.
Full sweep of Freyberg Place; welfare checks along O'Connell Street and Chancery Street, all clear. Heading back to HQ to charge the Ops Phone.
Arrived at HQ; charging the Ops Phone.
Full sweep of Queen Street; arrived at Britomart and commencing a sweep of the area.
Standing down from patrols — received a response call from McDonald's Queen Street regarding a vagrant inside the premises refusing to leave. En route to the location.
Arrived at the response location; the male vagrant was inside the premises taking shelter in the toilet area. Kindly asked him to vacate the premises, no issues. Standing by outside for any issues.
Welfare check at McDonald's Queen Street, all clear. Heading back to the office to commence a 30-minute break.
Arrived at HQ; commencing a 30-minute break (on break 05:41–05:50).
Break completed; standing by in the office awaiting guard handover.
Night shift concluded; handing over to the Morning Shift.

flags: CAPACITY: Three near-simultaneous calls 17:33–17:36 (Footlocker, management private-property request, Victoria Street convenience store) handled sequentially by one team — the 17:36 convenience-store call was attended at 18:10 (individual already gone); the 17:35 management request has no distinct attendance entry of its own.
QA: 12:38 Nike response call was cancelled by the caller (Police already on site) — counted as a call received; no Police interaction by the team.

capacity.note: Third of three near-simultaneous calls; individual already gone on arrival.
